key_insight: WEST is an open-source, GPU-accelerated excited-state simulation code that scales GW, BSE, and TDDFT to thousand-atom materials without explicitly computing virtual states.
engineering_relevance: For solar-cell materials engineering, WEST enables predictive screening and analysis of optical excitations, quasi-particle energies, and defect-related processes in complex perovskites and other condensed-phase systems.
method: Full-frequency GW, Bethe-Salpeter equation, and TDDFT in one framework
Low-rank dielectric screening and exact-exchange representations
Hierarchical parallelization plus GPU acceleration for strong scaling
evidence_signal: The abstract reports representative applications and near-ideal strong scaling to thousands of GPUs on systems with more than a thousand atoms, indicating both accuracy and scalability.
watch_item: Performance and accuracy depend on advanced HPC resources and careful workflow setup; the abstract does not provide detailed benchmark limits across all material classes or excitation types.
paper_title: The WEST code for large-scale excited-state materials simulations
